senses.gloss: m. (סָפַג) absorption, drying after a bath.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 1:4">Zab. I, 4</cite> <he>כדי טבילה וס׳</he> (not <he>וסיפג</he>) long enough to bathe and dry one’s self; <cite ref="Tosefta Zavim 1:9">Tosef. ib. I, 9</cite> (not <he>סופג</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Zavim 1:12">12</cite>, sq.; a. e.—Pl. <he>סִיפּוּגִים</he>, <he>סִיפּוּגִין</he>, <cite ref="O00783"><he>סִפּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 1:5">Zab. I, 5</cite> <he>שתי טבילות ושני ס׳</he> as much time as is required for twice bathing and getting dry.
<cite ref="Tosefta Zavim 1:10">Tosef. ib. I, 10</cite> <cite ref="O00781"><he>סיפגים</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
